newsitem.title: USA: Republic to buy two Florida firms.
newsitem.headline: Republic to buy two Florida firms.

text.p: Republic Industries Inc said Wednesday that is has signed definitive agreements to acquire two Florida car dealerships from Gulf Management Inc for $62 million in stock.
The dealerships to be purchased are Lexus of Tampa Bay and Lexus of Clearwater, and the Steve Moore General Motors automotive group of Palm Beach, it said.
The transactions include all related real estate, and are subject to certain conditions, including manufacturer and government approval, it said.

As part of the transactions, Ron Salhany, 48, and Steve Moore, 52, will enter into long-term employment agreements with Republic Industries and will retain their responsibilities at the dealerships, it said.

Republic is a diversified holding company which owns the nation's largest chain of new vehicle dealerships and AutoNation USA, a chain of used car stores erates under the brand name. Republic also owns National Car Rental System, Inc and Alamo Rent-A-Car, Inc and has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Spirit Rent-A-Car.
